dictation.mode.title: Mode

dictation.shortcut.title: Shortcut

dictation.dictionary.help: Names and technical terms Pennel should spell exactly this way.

dictation.pad.shortcut_help: Hold to speak. Double-tap for hands-free.
dictation.pad.button_help: You can use the button to dictate here.
dictation.pad.no_target: No target app is available. Your text stays here.
dictation.pad.local_target: Your text stays in Pennel. Copy it whenever you want.

dictation.home.title: Dictation
dictation.home.intro: Click a text field in another app. Hold your shortcut and speak. Release it to paste your text there.
dictation.home.shortcut: Hold to speak. Release to paste.
dictation.home.pad_help: Use this if you want to save or edit the text in Pennel first.
dictation.processing.cli: Via {provider}; destination depends on your CLI settings
dictation.processing.optional_destinatio: {provider} · only for summaries or questions, using the provider selected then

dictation.home.shortcut_copy: Speak, then copy and paste your text.
dictation.history.target_missing: This dictation could not be found in recent History.
dictation.pad.finish_before_leaving: Finish or cancel dictation before switching sections.
dictation.verification.title: Verify cleanup meaning
dictation.verification.help: An additional check of the cleaned text. Configuring a decision connection does not enable this feature.
dictation.verification.active: Verification is active for qualified cleanup.
dictation.verification.unavailable: Verification is unavailable for this cleanup task and language.
dictation.verification.unqualified: No model is qualified for this cleanup task and its content language yet.

dictation.verification.mutation_in_progr: The connection is being updated. Verification is unavailable until the update finishes.
dictation.verification.configuration_cha: The connection changed during this dictation. The original text is retained.
dictation.verification.inactive: Off — no text sent for verification
dictation.home.recent_empty: Your dictations appear here after you use your shortcut or try it in Pennel.

dictation.home.ready_intro: Click a text field in another app, then use your shortcut.

dictation.home.download_intro_unknown: Pennel needs a speech model before it can listen. Choose a setup to see its download size and processing destination.
dictation.home.release_help: Release, and your words land wherever your cursor is. Double-tap for hands-free.
dictation.home.field_help: Try your shortcut or Start dictation. Your words stay in this message.
dictation.home.result_here: Your words are here. Edit or copy them whenever you’re ready.

dictation.home.practice_blocked: Give Pennel microphone access to try it here.
